events.text: Spain has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

India has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Religious Idols (+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith for each Gold, [ICON_RES_SILVER] Silver, and [ICON_RES_COPPER] Copper)

Japan has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Beacon Light (+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness from [ICON_BUILDING_LIGHTHOUSE] Lighthouses)
The Shoshone have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of the Hunt (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food from Camps)
Greece has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Beast Totem (+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each [ICON_RES_DEER] Deer and [ICON_RES_BISON] Bison resource)

Denmark has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)
